title: CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

paragraphs.en: It was a glorious October when Anne returned to school. The mornings were filled with delicate mists, and the fields glistened like silver cloth. Anne felt happy as she sat at her desk beside Diana, with Ruby Gillis nodding across the aisle and Carrie Sloane sending notes.
paragraphs.zh: 当安妮回到学校时，正是十月黄金时节。清晨弥漫着轻柔的雾气，田野在阳光下闪烁，犹如银色的绸缎。安妮坐在戴安娜身旁的课桌上，对面上过道的朱比·吉里斯正打着盹儿，而卡莉·斯洛恩则在传递纸条，让安妮感到心情愉悦。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy, their new teacher, was a bright, sympathetic woman who won the hearts of her pupils. Under her influence, Anne thrived, sharing glowing accounts of schoolwork with Matthew and Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: 他们的新老师斯泰西小姐是一位聪明而富有同情心的女性，很快便赢得了学生的喜爱。在她的影响下，安妮进步显著，经常向马修和玛丽拉讲述她在学校里的种种精彩经历。

paragraphs.en: Anne adored Miss Stacy, finding her ladylike and having a sweet voice. She felt instinctively that Miss Stacy spelled her name correctly. During recitations, Anne poured her soul into her performance, particularly when reciting "Mary, Queen of Scots."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮非常喜爱斯泰西小姐，觉得她举止文雅，声音甜美。安妮直觉地认为斯泰西小姐拼写她的名字是正确的。在朗读时，安妮总是全身心投入，尤其是在朗读《玛丽·斯图亚特女王》的时候。

paragraphs.en: Ruby Gillis told Anne that she made her blood run cold with the line, "Now for my father's arm," and "my woman's heart farewell."
paragraphs.zh: 鲁比·吉尔思告诉安妮，她用“现在向我父亲的胳膊告别”和“永别了我的女人的心”这两句话让她不寒而栗。

paragraphs.en: Matthew suggested Anne recite it in the barn. Anne agreed but noted that it wouldn't be as exciting without a whole school listening.
paragraphs.zh: 马修建议安妮在谷仓里背诵。安妮同意了，但她指出没有全校师生聆听的话，气氛就不会那么激动人心了。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy proposed a concert to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag, much to the delight of her students, especially Anne. Despite Marilla’s skepticism, Anne eagerly embraced the idea, seeing it as an opportunity to showcase their talents.
paragraphs.zh: 斯泰西小姐提议举办一场音乐会以筹集学校旗帜的资金，学生们听后欣喜若狂，尤其是安妮。尽管玛丽拉对此持怀疑态度，但安妮却热情地接受了这个建议，视之为展示自己才华的好机会。

paragraphs.en: "Mrs. Lynde was shocked by the boys climbing trees on Bell's hill last Friday," Marilla said. "I can't understand Miss Stacy encouraging such behavior."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉说：“雷切尔·林德太太上周五对贝尔山上的男孩们爬树感到十分震惊。”“我实在不明白斯泰西小姐怎么会鼓励这种行为。”

paragraphs.en: "But we were doing nature study," Anne explained. "Miss Stacy makes everything so clear. And I love writing compositions, even though geometry is a challenge for me."
paragraphs.zh: “但我们正在做自然观察，”安妮解释说，“斯泰西小姐把一切都讲得明明白白。而且我甚至喜欢写作文，尽管几何对我来说是个挑战。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla dismissed physical culture exercises as nonsense but Anne was enthusiastic about them too, finding them graceful and beneficial.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉 dismiss 物理锻炼这类活动为胡说八道，但安妮对此也很热衷，认为它们优雅且有益。

paragraphs.en: In November, Miss Stacy announced the concert plan. The students enthusiastically agreed, and preparations began immediately. Anne, despite Marilla’s disapproval, threw herself into organizing the event wholeheartedly.
paragraphs.zh: 十一月里，斯泰西小姐提出了举办音乐会的计划。学生们热情地表示赞同，筹备工作随即展开。尽管玛丽拉不太赞成，安妮却全身心地投入到这场活动的组织中。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy disapproved of the concert and practices, believing they were a waste of time that should be spent on lessons. She argued that such activities made children vain and overly social.
paragraphs.zh: 斯泰西小姐反对举办音乐会和排练，认为这些活动浪费了本应用来上课的时间，并且会让孩子变得虚荣和过于好社交。

paragraphs.en: Anne pleaded for the concert's patriotic value. "A flag can inspire a sense of patriotism," she said to Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮为音乐会的爱国意义辩护说：“一面旗帜能够激发人们的爱国情怀。”她对玛丽拉说道。

paragraphs.en: Marilla dismissed her concerns, saying there was little genuine patriotism among them. All they wanted was fun.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉打消了她的顾虑，说她们当中几乎没有真正的爱国热情，她们只想图个乐子。

paragraphs.en: The girls were excited about their roles. Anne would perform two recitations and be in two dialogues: 'The Society for the Suppression of Gossip' and 'The Fairy Queen.' Diana would sing a solo, and the boys had a dialogue too.
paragraphs.zh: 女孩子们对各自的演出角色兴奋不已。安妮将进行两段朗诵，并参与两个对话节目：“抑制流言蜚语协会”和“仙后”。戴安娜则独唱一首歌曲，而男生们也准备了一个对话节目。

paragraphs.en: They planned six choruses and a tableau at the end—'Faith, Hope, and Charity.'
paragraphs.zh: 他们计划了六个合唱部分，并在结尾处安排了一个场景表演——“信仰、希望与慈善”。

paragraphs.en: Anne intended to practice her recitations in the attic. She warned Marilla not to worry if she heard groaning; it was necessary for one of her performances.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮打算在阁楼上练习她的朗诵。她警告玛丽拉，如果听到她在呻吟不要担心，这是为了其中一次表演做准备的。

paragraphs.en: Josie Pye was sulking because she didn't get the part she wanted in a dialogue. She had hoped to be 'The Fairy Queen,' but that would have been ridiculous, given Josie's size.
paragraphs.zh: 乔西·皮抱怨着，因为她没有得到对话中的一个重要角色。她曾希望能扮演“仙后”，但考虑到乔西的身材，这未免有些滑稽。

paragraphs.en: Jane Andrews would play 'The Fairy Queen,' and Anne would be one of her maids of honor. Anne planned to wear a wreath of white roses and borrow Ruby Gillis' slippers for the performance.
paragraphs.zh: 简·安德鲁斯将演奏《仙后》，而安妮则会是她的女伴之一。安妮打算佩戴一顶白玫瑰花环，并借瑞比·吉尔斯的舞鞋参加演出。

paragraphs.en: They intended to decorate the hall with spruce branches and fir mottoes adorned with pink tissue-paper roses. After everyone was seated, they would march in pairs while Emma White played a march on the organ.
paragraphs.zh: 他们打算用云杉枝和装饰着粉红色皱纹纸玫瑰的松树横幅来装饰大厅。等大家坐定后，他们会成对入场，在艾玛·怀特在风琴上演奏进行曲时依次走过。

paragraphs.en: Anne sighed and went to the backyard, where a young moon shone through leafless poplar branches under an apple-green sky. Matthew was splitting wood there. She perched on a block and discussed the concert with him.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮叹了口气，走到后院。一轮新月透过光秃秃的白杨树枝洒下银辉，天空呈现出苹果般的绿色。马修正在劈柴。她坐在一块木头上，与他讨论起音乐会的事宜。

paragraphs.en: Matthew smiled at her eager face. "I reckon it's going to be a good concert, and you'll do fine," he said. Anne smiled back.
paragraphs.zh: 马修看着她充满期待的脸庞，露出了微笑：“我想这次音乐会一定会办得很成功，你也会表现得不错。”他说。安妮也回以一笑。

paragraphs.en: They were close friends, and Matthew often thanked his stars for not having raised her. Marilla was in charge of that duty. Matthew could "spoil" Anne as much as he liked without worrying about conflicts between inclination and responsibility.
paragraphs.zh: 她们是亲密的朋友，马修常常感谢自己的运气，庆幸没有娶她为妻。这项责任由玛丽拉承担。马修可以尽情宠着安妮，无需担心个人意愿与职责之间的冲突。

paragraphs.en: This arrangement suited him well; a little appreciation sometimes did more good than all the conscientious bringing up in the world.
paragraphs.zh: 这个安排他挺满意；偶尔得到一点认可比世界上所有的循规蹈矩都要来得更有益。
